scope: Prospective fixture-only approval lineage and canonical-preflight binding; not active Runtime V2/CLI/tool/executor wiring, real execution, provider, chemistry, evaluation, replication, training, paper, release, or SOTA evidence.

supported: The isolated fixture accepted exactly one matching user-only lineage and refused the declared receipt, lineage, timing, schema, target, request-drift, and reuse cases before fake dispatch.
qualified: The current full Click-schema digest is derived and checked only within the fixture; it is not active CLI enforcement.
unresolved: No durable, active executor-side approval consumption is implemented.
No P1, P3, P4, P5, or P6 gate is promoted by this fixture protocol.
rejected: The fixture authorizes a real command, provider, engine, scheduler, chemical result, or held-out evaluation.

failure_ledger.failure: P2B-v1 cannot establish a typed preflight receipt's canonical digest, command digest, and gates against the request binding.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A fixture should bind one acceptable archived-shaped receipt and fail closed on substitution or unsuitable gates.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add an unwired v2 receipt-hash checker only.
failure_ledger.evidence: Direct local receipt-shape fixtures and focused deterministic outcomes.
failure_ledger.result: Focused fixture cases passed; exact acceptable receipt binding and declared receipt failures were observed only in memory.
failure_ledger.limitation: No production preflight or command execution is exercised.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Delete only the v2 fixture protocol if unsuitable; preserve P2B-v1.

failure_ledger.failure: P2B-v1 does not model actor provenance, typed Runtime V2 timing, invalidation history, or duplicate terminal refusal.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A future executor needs ordered user-only lineage facts in addition to an outer binding.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add an in-memory lineage evaluator that consumes no dispatcher.
failure_ledger.evidence: Typed resolution/invalidation fixtures and fake-dispatch counters.
failure_ledger.result: Focused fixture cases passed; user-only, duplicate, stale, invalidated, and mistimed lineages failed closed before fake dispatch.
failure_ledger.limitation: No persistence, concurrency, UI, or active enforcement is exercised.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Any active lineage migration needs separate design and authority.

failure_ledger.failure: A supplied 64-character schema string alone does not prove derivation from current schema content.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: The fixture should recompute metadata from a supplied schema body before comparing pins.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Validate a copied in-memory schema document locally without changing Click.
failure_ledger.result: A copied in-memory schema-content change recomputed to a distinct digest and failed the pinned binding.
failure_ledger.limitation: Schema content is not all runtime behavior.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Retire only this fixture check if a versioned executor contract supersedes it.

failure_ledger.failure: The first closed receipt-wrapper invocation rejected its own phase-close command field as prohibited raw content before fixture evaluation.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Validation provenance commands are safe local check identifiers, while raw execution command strings must remain prohibited.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Remove only the generic command key from the validator denylist and retain command_string plus secret, prompt, response, argument, and error-text exclusions.
failure_ledger.evidence: One focused wrapper failure reporting a generic redaction-field error before fixture evaluation.
failure_ledger.result: After the narrowly scoped validator repair, one justified focused wrapper rerun passed.
failure_ledger.limitation: The repair validates receipt shape only and does not exercise a command executor.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Restore a stricter key rule only if phase-close evidence moves to a dedicated safe field without breaking receipt provenance.
